item.title: Middle East Eye: Gaza death toll rises
item.description: Gaza death toll rises Hospitals in Gaza have recorded seven deaths over the past 48 hours, with one of those a person who succumbed to previous injuries, the Palestinian Ministry of Health in Gaza reported. The ministry said 38 people were injured during the same period. Since the “ceasefire” in October 2025, Israel has killed 1,415 Palestinians in Gaza and injured 4,953. A total of 74,016 people have been killed since 7 October 2023, and 175,068 have been injured.

item.title: Middle East Eye: Iraq says US agrees to continue cash dollar shipments
item.description: Iraq says US agrees to continue cash dollar shipments Iraq has reached an understanding with the United States to continue dollar cash shipments to Iraq, with a new shipment expected in the coming days, a government spokesperson told the Iraqi News Agency on Saturday. The US resumed some dollar cash shipments to Iraq in July after a months -long suspension, according to Iraqi officials, after Washington halted a shipment of about $500 million in April.

item.description: Trump rejects Iranian proposal to open Hormuz and end war US President Donald Trump said on Saturday he had rejected an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end the Iran war. item.title: Middle East Eye: Israeli gunfire kills child in Gaza
item.description: Israeli gunfire kills child in Gaza A child has been killed by Israeli gunfire in Rafah’s al-Mawasi, in the southern Gaza Strip, Al Jazeera Arabic reported, citing ambulance and emergency sources. Earlier today, Israeli forces shot and killed a Palestinian in the Jabalia refugee camp in northern Gaza. Israel has already killed more than 1,400 people in the strip since last year’s “ceasefire”.

The database is highly sensitive as firms could be targeted for boycotts or divestment to pressure Israel over settler expansion in the territory that is home to over three million Palestinians. item.description: Israeli forces storm West Bank towns, fire stun grenades at al-Am'ari refugee camp Israeli forces stormed the Qalandia refugee camp in the occupied West Bank, but there were no reports of immediate arrests, Wafa reported.
